teaser_copy.seo_title: Bau Noir Haus: Monochrome Bauhaus Geometry in Generative Abstraction
teaser_copy.seo_description: A monochrome generative collection exploring Bauhaus inspired geometry, stark contrast, and disciplined balance for modern graphic panels.
teaser_copy.page_subtitle: Monochrome Bauhaus geometry with disciplined balance and contrast.

page_copy.pattern: Bauhaus geometry favors clarity: precise shapes, high contrast, and balanced grids that read instantly and scale cleanly.
page_copy.action: A generative pipeline produced core forms and layout, then in painting refined edge quality, contrast discipline, and spatial balance.
page_copy.measured: Yields crisp panels that perform at tile scale and hold integrity for print, social showcases, and provenance linked digital editions.
